text: Yahoo operates as a standalone company owned by funds managed by affiliates of Apollo Global Management, which completed its acquisition of Yahoo (formerly Verizon Media) in September 2021; Verizon retained a 10% stake.

source.name: Apollo Global Management: Apollo Funds Complete Acquisition of Yahoo
source.quote: funds managed by its affiliates (the “Apollo Funds”) have completed the acquisition of Yahoo - formerly Verizon Media
